test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A and B can complete a task in 6 and 8 days, respectively. They work on alternate days, with A starting the task on the first day. How many days will it take them to complete the task?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete the task = 6 days

Time taken by B to complete the task = 8 days

A works on the first day, then B on the second day, and so on.

**Formula used:**

Work done by A in one day = 1/6

Work done by B in one day = 1/8

Total work done in two days = Work done by A in one day + Work done by B in one day

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in one day = 1/6

Work done by B in one day = 1/8

Total work done in two days = 1/6 + 1/8

⇒ Total work done in two days = 1/6 + 1/8

⇒ Total work done in two days = (4 + 3)/24

⇒ Total work done in two days = 7/24

Work done in 6 days (3 cycles of 2 days) = 3 × 7/24

⇒ Work done in 6 days = 21/24

Remaining work after 6 days = 1 - 21/24

⇒ Remaining work = 3/24

⇒ Remaining work = 1/8

On the 7th day, A will complete the remaining work.

Work done by A in one day = 1/6

Time taken by A to complete the remaining work = (1/8)/(1/6)

⇒ Time taken by A = 6/8

⇒ Time taken by A = 3/4 day

Total time to complete the task = 6 days + 3/4 day

⇒ Total time = 6(3)/(4) days

**∴ The task will be completed in 6(3)/(4) days.**
